assertions.name: rsk_form_and_bijection_exact
assertions.source: Literal Schensted enumeration of S_k (k≤7): shape-count = (f^λ)² (RSK bijection) and Σ_{w}χ^{sh(w)}(3-cycle) = Σ_λ(f^λ)²χ³ = 3cov/(k)₃ < 0, all exact. Verifies the RSK form; open kernel T₃≤0 unproved. No fit; no c_k.

description: DIRECT RSK-enumeration verification of the RSK form of the Δ_λ covariance kernel T₃ (epic qou-x631 / bean qou-joi7 Phase 2). Existing probes compute only the closed form Σ_λ(f^λ)²χ^λ(3-cycle) via hook dimensions; this probe LITERALLY enumerates S_k and applies Schensted row-insertion to every permutation word, confirming EXACTLY (k=3..7): (i) #{w∈S_k : sh(w)=λ} = (f^λ)² (RSK bijection S_k ≅ ⊔_λ SYT(λ)²); (ii) Σ_{w∈S_k} χ^{sh(w)}(3-cycle) = Σ_λ(f^λ)²χ^λ(3-cycle) = T₃ (the RSK form); (iii) T₃ = 3·cov(k)/(k)₃ < 0 with cov(k)=Σ(f^λ)³(Σc²−C(k,2)). χ^λ(3-cycle) by Murnaghan–Nakayama (signed 3-ribbon removal). Verifies the RSK form the Phase-2 genus expansion rests on; does NOT prove the open kernel T₃≤0. scope-(a); no fit; nothing wired; no c_k.
